text:
Which statement about evaporation is correct?
A
Evaporation causes heating of the liquid.
B
Evaporation only happens from liquids.
C
Molecules escape from anywhere in the liquid.
D
Only the least energetic molecules escape.

options.label: A
options.text: Evaporation causes heating of the liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: Molecules escape from anywhere in the liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the least energetic molecules escape.
